title: Little John
desc: To please his girlfriend's parents, an American seeks the help of a guru to make him invisible. However, he shrinks and must find a special ring to restore himself to his normal size.

title: Sagotharan
desc: A former soldier returns to his hometown and goes in search of his elder brother. However, he unknowingly enters the world of crime and must struggle for survival.

title: Vinnukum Mannukum
desc: Selvam, a young man, returns to his village after living abroad and wishes to marry Devayani, an actress and the girl of his dreams. However, things become complicated when she rudely rejects him.

title: Poomagal Oorvalam
desc: Sarvanan, adopted by a childless couple, falls in love with Kavitha, the daughter of a caste-obsessed Sengodan. Soon, Sarvanan tries to change Sengodan's attitude in order to marry Kavitha.

title: Poove Unakkaga
desc: Raja learns that the girl he loves is in love with another man. When he comes to know about the long-standing dispute between both their families, he goes to their village to unite them.
